blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) on Friday said it is speeding up the construction of relocation sites for families affected by the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR) in Pampanga. The 147-kilometer railway system is set to connect Metro Manila with Pampanga and Laguna, with its partial operation scheduled in 2028. The DOTr said it is closely monitoring the construction of the housing units in San Fernando View Residences in Mexico and Casa de Angeles in Angeles City to ensure they stay on track for the target completion date.
